name: Saa S Performance Audit
prompt: "Create a 'SaaS Subscription Audit' dashboard. The user inputs their recurring software subscriptions with fields: Name, Cost, Billing Frequency (Monthly/Annual), Next Renewal Date, and Usage Frequency (High/Medium/Low).

thought_process.interpretation: I am acting as an Expert React Developer building a specialized financial audit tool. The goal is to create a functional dashboard where users can track and evaluate their SaaS footprint, focusing on cost-efficiency and usage-to-value ratios. I interpreted 'Audit' as needing both a registry of subscriptions and analytical visualizations to identify potential savings.
skills_utilized: Dynamic state management for CRUD operations
Normalization of billing frequencies (Monthly vs Annual)
Responsive UI design with Tailwind CSS
assumed_from_scratch: A cost normalization engine to compare Monthly and Annual plans side-by-side
A categorical mapping for common SaaS tools (DevTools, Productivity, Infra, etc.)
Logic to calculate 'Cost per Usage' metrics to highlight waste
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Future iterations should include a 'Projected Savings' component that automatically calculates ROI if low-usage subscriptions are cancelled. Integrating a 'Category' field would allow for spend-by-department analysis.
